items.title: Window-label AND calendar-day advance across the weekend (after-hours 2026-08-02 -> pre-market 2026-08-03) on an UNADVANCED completed equity bar (still 2026-07-31), where an OPTIONS-only snapshot refresh materially REPRICES the gamma / dealer-structure layer while every completed-equity-bar-anchored tool stays frozen - the options-snapshot clock and the completed-equity-bar frontier decouple, and persistence must NOT increment.
items.note: Genuinely new versus the prior 'same-window zero-drift re-quote' pattern (after-hours -> after-hours, byte-identical values). Three facts distinguish this run: (1) BOTH THE WINDOW LABEL AND THE CALENDAR DAY ADVANCE (window after-hours -> pre-market; todayEt 2026-08-02 -> 2026-08-03) yet dataFreshness.bars.expectedSessionDate is UNCHANGED at 2026-07-31 (287/287 fresh, 0 carried, 0 missing) because 08-01/08-02 are the weekend and 08-03 has not yet closed - so no NEW completed daily bar exists. (2) THE OPTIONS LAYER MATERIALLY DRIFTS on fresh 08-03 snapshots (22 symbols, updated 2026-08-03T11:00:14.897Z): signedNetGEX +2.199B -> +6.199B, spot 747.03 -> 751.05, flip 740.09 -> 742.49, walls 741/749 -> 747/752, expected move ±4.27 -> ±3.65, atmIV 7.72% -> 6.57% - a genuine reprice, NOT a byte-identical re-quote; alongside BTC-USD 31.6 -> 33.3 (new 2026-08-03T00:00:00.000Z daily stamp), global-rotation EWS 84.3 -> 84.1 with the #2 slot flipping EWU -> EPHE, and VIX 15.99 -> 15.95 (band 'VIX 16.0' -> 'VIX 15.9'). (3) THE COMPLETED-EQUITY-BAR-ANCHORED TOOLS STAY FROZEN on 07-31: SPY 747.03 bull-stack (+0.38% vs 50d, +7.12% vs 200d, -1.4% from the 52w high, +8.21% 6m, +19.05% 12m), the sector RRG (XLY into quad I accel +0.9, XLE out quad L, XLV leader quad W) byte-identical, swing Bull-stacked, heatmap breadth 48.64% narrow, vol-sizing forecast 13.9101% throttle ×1.08. Signature: a window/day rollover can advance the snapshot clock and materially reprice the options-derived gamma layer while the equity-bar frontier is unmoved - two clocks that normally move together here diverge - and this MUST NOT move persistence.
items.method: Extend the off-hours-carry detector with an 'options-clock-vs-equity-bar-frontier decoupling' test that fires when snapshot.window AND meta.todayEt both advance while dataFreshness.bars.expectedSessionDate is unchanged AND dataFreshness.options.updated advances into a new calendar day AND the gamma/structure levels move materially. Trigger on SIX tests: (1) WINDOW + DAY ADVANCE = snapshot.window changes (after-hours -> pre-market) and meta.todayEt changes (2026-08-02 -> 2026-08-03); (2) EQUITY BAR FRONTIER UNCHANGED = dataFreshness.bars.expectedSessionDate still 2026-07-31 with freshSymbolCount == symbolCount and carriedSymbolCount == 0 and missingSymbolCount == 0 (287/287, 0, 0) - a same-bar re-price across the weekend, NOT an append; (3) OPTIONS CLOCK ADVANCES = dataFreshness.options.updated advances into 2026-08-03 (2026-08-03T11:00:14.897Z, 22/22 fresh); (4) MATERIAL GAMMA REPRICE = signedNetGEX / spot / flipLevel / callWall / putWall / expectedMove / atmIV all change versus the prior window (deltas: GEX +2.199B->+6.199B, spot 747.03->751.05, flip 740.09->742.49, walls 741/749->747/752, EM 4.27->3.65, atmIV 0.0772->0.0657); (5) EQUITY-BAR-ANCHORED TOOLS FROZEN = regime + bench and the sector RRG metrics are byte-identical to the equity-bar layer (SPY 747.03 bull-stack; XLY into / XLE out / XLV leader) even as VIX ticks 15.99->15.95; (6) PERSISTENCE MUST NOT INCREMENT = because no NEW distinct completed bar date exists, distinct-bar counts hold (XLY rotate-into stays early-persistent across [2026-07-30, 2026-07-31] = 2; the structural tools stay at 1 = [2026-07-31]). HARD RULE: count persistence by DISTINCT completed market-bar dates only - a new window label, a new calendar day, and an options-only reprice NEVER increment the counter; only a new distinct completed daily bar does.

bars.note: The completed 07-31 daily session is the frontier; the 08-01/08-02 weekend added no bar and 08-03 has not closed, so this pre-market window re-prices the SAME 07-31 bar (287/287 fresh, 0 carried, 0 missing).
